title: Grilled Beef Bo Kho
description: A twist on the classic Vietnamese beef stew, this Italian-inspired recipe features a rich and flavorful bo kho served with a side of crusty bread.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef bo and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the pot, then add the sliced onions.
Cook the onions until they are softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, fish sauce, and kho spices to the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the beef is tender, about 2 1/2 hours.
Season the bo kho with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the bo kho hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
